scope: W2E-B — external-source recovery for the 22 identifiers unresolved after W2E-A2 (previously classified absent_all_sources: 3 NorTaxa + 19 iNaturalist).

count_reconciliation.note: Distinct-external-IDs and observation-counts are different measurements; the earlier prose that used them interchangeably is corrected here.
count_reconciliation.explanation_of_delta: The prior diagnostic classified 24 distinct external identifiers as absent_all_sources based on probes of taxon_external_id_min and taxon_min.inaturalist_taxon_id only. Two of the 5 NorTaxa IDs then classified as absent (41020336 and 41096500) are in fact anchored in the canonical registry under (nortaxa, nortaxa_taxon_id). The W2D-R diagnostic classifier did not probe the registry directly — it treated registry hits under the 'outside_release_scope' bucket only when the release backbone also lacked the concept. After the W2E-A Part A resolver change lifted the release-membership gate on Level 4, those two IDs resolved via canonical registry, leaving 22 truly unresolved identifiers. The 22-observation / 24-ID / 22-distinct-ID chain is now internally consistent (each remaining unresolved observation carries exactly one distinct exact signal).

supplement_contract_formalisation.identity_records_changed_note: The release JSON gained artifact_kind, supplement_release_id, base_release_id, base_release_dependency (with export/scope manifest SHAs), depends_on, required_application_order, and compatibility_rules. The registry shard JSONL, registry manifest.json, and taxon_external_id_supplement.jsonl remain byte-identical to the W2E-A2 output.

w2ea2_shard_ordering_bug_fix.defect: The W2E-A2 shard emitted the synonym alias line BEFORE its accepted-target anchor line because the writer sorted by (sporely_taxon_id, kind) where 'alias' < 'anchor' lexicographically. Reconciliation.CLI's shard indexer loaded the file correctly (it does not enforce anchor-before-alias), but IdentityRegistry.load() rejects a bare alias whose anchor has not yet been consumed on the same load pass.
w2ea2_shard_ordering_bug_fix.detection: The W2E-B allocator failed at startup when absorbing the W2E-A2 supplement as depends-on, raising 'registry line 22 alias references unknown anchor sporely_taxon_id 634916'.
w2ea2_shard_ordering_bug_fix.fix: sort key changed to (sporely_taxon_id, 0 if kind=='anchor' else 1) in database/taxonomy/scripts/allocate_observation_derived_anchors.py. The regenerated shard now loads through both code paths.
w2ea2_shard_ordering_bug_fix.identity_records_changed_note: The 22 JSONL lines carry the same (sporely_taxon_id, source, namespace, identifier, kind) tuples in both versions; only the emit ORDER changed. No sporely_taxon_id was renumbered or reassigned.

correct_supplement_application_order.note: The reconciliation engine consumes supplements in the order supplied to --canonical-registry (base, W2E-A2, W2E-B). The W2E-B supplement's contract declares depends_on=['tax-2026.08.02-01'] and its allocator refuses to run without --depends-on-supplement pointing at that path. The W2E-B allocator loads that supplement into the working registry to obtain the correct baseline_next_id, so allocation order is deterministic. Reordering the CLI flags produces a different (also deterministic) manifest, but only the declared order satisfies the supplement contract.
